name: AP_INV_SELECTION_CRITERIA_ALL
description: AP_INVOICE_SELECTION_CRITERIA_ALL stores the criteria that a payment batch uses to select invoices for payment.  Your Oracle Payables application creates one row each time you initiate a payment batch.  Your Oracle Payables application uses  this information to guide AutoSelect in selecting invoices for payment. This table corresponds to the Create Payment Request page.

columns.name: CHECKRUN_NAME
columns.description: Name of payment process request submitted.

columns.name: INV_AWT_EXISTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that payment process request contains invoices with withholding tax group associated with them.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE

columns.name: ACCELERATED_INVOICES_CODE

columns.name: SOURCE_GROUP_OPTION

columns.name: THRESHOLD_OPTION_CODE

columns.name: THRESHOLD_AMOUNT
